outcome: red blood cell count in CSF
rate of sending CSF samples to laboratory
cohort: Neonates who underwent lumbar puncture over an eight-year period in a level three neonatal intensive care unit of a teaching hospital.
finding: The study found that the likelihood of traumatic lumbar puncture (TLP) decreased with increasing postnatal age in both term and preterm neonates, while no significant association was observed with birth weight, birth weight percentile, gestational week, or year of procedure.
